Characteristics [Category]: bulk ATAC-seq chromatin accessibility profiling of a transformed human embryonic kidney-derived cell line
Material Type: Bulk Assay for Transposase-Accessible Chromatin using sequencing (bulk ATAC-seq) on HEK293T cells, a transformed derivative of HEK293 carrying SV40 large T antigen, used as an epithelial-like embryonic kidney/neuroectoderm-associated model for transfection, viral packaging, and regulatory genomics.
Parameter [dna_extraction]: Bulk ATAC-seq nuclei preparation from a population of cultured cells: intact nuclei are isolated, permeabilized, and incubated with Tn5 transposase to tag accessible chromatin before PCR amplification and sequencing.
